purpose: Illustrative EXAMPLE allowlist. Defines what MAY be replicated off-machine (e.g. cloud drive, docs, notes app) in addition to your local encrypted backups. Local backups (the internxt-*.sh scripts + git) are unrestricted; THIS file is a pattern for gating anything that leaves the machine to a less-controlled destination. Adapt the include/exclude globs to your own project before using this pattern for real.
status: EXAMPLE — not wired to any script in this directory; copy and adapt
cloud_targets_note: Replace with whatever off-machine destinations you actually use (cloud drive, docs, notes sync). Anything copied into a locally-synced folder is a publication event just like an explicit upload.
include_cloud_safe: docs/**.md                          — public-facing docs, verified no PII/credentials
exclude_hard_local_only: clients/**, customers/**            — any per-customer or per-client data
.git/** internals                   — a git bundle is your repo backup; cloud gets readable docs only
rules: Default-deny: a path is replicable ONLY if it matches include_cloud_safe AND matches no exclude pattern.
Per-file PII/credential scan before the FIRST upload of any included path; halt + surface on any hit.
This allowlist is itself local-only and never uploaded.
Re-approve when the include set changes.
